title: Echo Okuva Ku Mpenda y'Ekibuga
intro: Mu kibuga ekyava ku bulagirizi bwa Katonda, omuntu eyali yekka yava ku njegoyego, ng’adduka n’obubaka obw’essuubi n’okulabula. Omwoyo guno ogwerabirwa gwandifuuse akabonero akataggwaawo ak’okukkiriza okunywevu.
clues: Nalaba ababaka nga basindikibwa mu kibuga kyange, naye abantu bange ne babagoba ng’abantu ba bulijjo.
Nakkiririza mu bubaka bwabwe era nawulira amazima nga gawulikika mu bulamu bwange.
Nakoowoola abantu bange okugondera ababaka abaasaba empeera yonna.
Nadduka okuva ku nkomerero y’ekibuga esinga okuba ewala, nga ngezaako mu bwangu okubalaga ensonga.
Abantu bange ne banziyiza, ne nttibwa, naye ne nfuna emirembe emirembe gyonna.
Allah n’aŋŋamba nti, ‘Yingira ejjana,’ era ne njagala abantu bange babeere bajulizi ku kitiibwa ekyampeereddwa.
arabic: قِيلَ ٱدْخُلِ ٱلْجَنَّةَ ۖ قَالَ يَـٰلَيْتَ قَوْمِى يَعْلَمُونَ
verse: It was said, "Enter Paradise." He said, "I wish my people could know (36:26)
